featured_reviews.review_text: I had a horrendous experience with Pink Homes, especially with brokers Rahul and Pramod. From the start, they run a disgusting bait-and-switch: showing you a series of awful properties, then presenting one decent one to trap you. After signing, it escalates horribly. They hound you for references, and even after paying rent on time, they harass you with false accusations—claiming you host guests, drink, smoke, or damage the place. Each repair request is twisted, and after a few months, Rahul and Pramod even escalate to physical visits, intimidating you in person. If you don’t give them further business, they will harass you relentlessly, push you to give notice, and invent excuses to force you out so they can profit from a new client. Once you give notice, they treat you disgustingly—speaking rudely, forging bills, and trying to rob you of your rightful deposit. Avoid Pink Homes and these brokers at all costs—this is a vicious, exploitative cycle that will leave you robbed and disrespected. They exploit college students the most, so BEWARE!

featured_reviews.review_text:
PG Is genuine but
The owner haven't listed it online
Don't fall for scam visit place and talk to owner directly
A lot of online listings host will contact you and tell token money for visiting card first they will ask you for 2000 and after the payment they will payment haven't received properly make another 3k payment and both the amount will refund you once you reach location
The scammer name is Sanjay Singh
I got his number from housing.com
I lost my 9k in this scam please be avair guys
Again don't fall for any such scam
PG is genuine do directly to location owner is one maharashtrian lady talk to her directly for PG

featured_reviews.review_text:
It's a good hostel if you want some cheap stay in Mumbai for more than a month. The pods are for ₹6500 (upper) and ₹7000( lower).  If u calculate it's less than ₹250 per day if ur staying on monthly basis. It's on harbour line and nearest station is of Cotton Green. The facilities are also cool like Wifi, clothes are washed and ironed. All these are included in the amount.
They also provide breakfast but it's paid. Nothing in breakfast varieties but can do.

Others it's upon individual experience.
